name: A brand new visitor can register and the account id is issued
description: Walks the public registration wizard end to end as a first-time visitor and confirms an account id comes back.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Orders/New as a visitor who is not signed in. This is a four step wizard: Service, Customer, Installation, Account
On step 1 pick a connection type, a plan and a billing cycle, then click Next
On step 2 fill Full Name with E2E New Visitor, Mobile Number with 0300-1112223 including the dash and CNIC with 42101-9876543-1. Click Next
On step 3 fill Installation Address with 9 Newcomer Road Lahore, choose the first city in the dropdown, and fill Existing Landline with 021-7654321. Click Next
On step 4 fill Password and Confirm Password both with Visitor@1234 and tick the terms checkbox
Submit the final step and wait for the page to navigate
Assert registration succeeded and a confirmation is shown. If the wizard is still displayed with validation errors, this test must fail.

name: A newly registered customer can sign in and lands on their own dashboard
description: Uses the credentials chosen at registration to sign in and confirms the customer portal opens.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login

Sign in with the account id or email of the customer registered by the previous signup test, using the password Visitor@1234. If the account id is not known, sign in with bilal.khan@example.com and Nexus@2026 instead and note that the signup account was unavailable
Assert the browser lands on /Customer/Dashboard and no login error is shown
Assert the page shows the signed-in customer's own name and no other customer's name

name: Order id and account id follow the documented formats
description: Confirms the generated identifiers match the formats the specification requires.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Orders and open the most recently created order
Assert the order id is eleven characters long and begins with a letter
Navigate to /Retail/Search and open the newest customer record
Assert the customer account id is sixteen characters long and is made of letters and digits

name: A generated bill charges service tax at the specified rate
description: Reads a bill breakdown and confirms the tax line is 12.24 percent of the taxable amount.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Open the most recent bill from the billing screens and read its subtotal, discount, taxable amount, service tax and total
Assert the taxable amount equals the subtotal minus the discount
Assert the service tax is the taxable amount multiplied by 0.1224, allowing one cent of rounding. If the rate differs, this test must fail.
Assert the total equals the taxable amount plus the service tax

name: Bulk discount applies to the advance and security deposit only
description: Confirms the discount line is computed on the discountable charges rather than the whole subtotal.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Open a bill that carries both a rental line and an advance payment line, and read every line and the discount figure
Assert the discount amount is not equal to the whole subtotal multiplied by the discount rate. Rentals must be excluded from the discount base.
Assert the discount line description names the advance and security deposit as its base

name: The advance payment is adjusted against a bill only once
description: Confirms the first payment is credited a single time rather than on every billing period.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Open the billing screens and run billing for the current month, then open the bill produced for the connection that paid an advance at signup
Assert the advance appears as a negative line on this bill
Run billing again for the following month and open that bill
Assert the advance does NOT appear on the second bill. If it is credited twice, this test must fail.

name: A one-off charge raised today lands on the next generated bill
description: Raises a replacement charge and confirms billing picks it up as a line item.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Charges and raise a replacement charge of 250 with the description E2E Pending Charge against the first available connection
Assert the charge is listed in the pending charges table
Run billing for the current period and open the resulting bill
Assert a line named E2E Pending Charge with amount 250 appears on the bill

name: A one-off charge cannot be cancelled once billed
description: Confirms a charge that has already been billed is no longer cancellable.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Charges and look at the pending charges table
Assert a charge that has already been placed on a bill is not offered a cancel control

name: Advanced search narrows results by customer name
description: Confirms the advanced search applies its filters server side and returns matching rows.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Search/Advanced and search for the customer name Bilal
Assert at least one row is returned and every returned row matches the search term
Change the search term to a string that cannot match anything, such as ZZZNoSuchCustomer
Assert no customer rows are returned and the page shows an empty result state rather than an error

name: Order tracking finds a real order and shows its status
description: Tracks an order that exists and confirms the timeline reflects the stored status.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Orders and copy the order id of the first order in the list
Navigate to /Orders/Tracking and search for that order id
Assert the order is found and its current status is displayed together with at least one timeline entry

name: A plan can be retired and brought back
description: Confirms the active flag on a plan can be toggled in both directions.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Plans and note a plan that is currently active
Set that plan inactive using the control provided on the list
Assert the plan is now shown as inactive
Set the same plan active again
Assert the plan is shown as active again, confirming the change is reversible

name: A city can be stopped and started without losing its record
description: Confirms turning a city off keeps the record and turning it back on restores service.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Settings/Cities and stop serving the first city in the list
Assert the city is still listed but marked as not serving
Turn that city back on
Assert the city is marked as serving again

name: Discount slabs are listed and editable
description: Confirms the bulk discount tiers are visible and can be changed.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Settings/Discounts
Assert the screen lists discount slabs covering the tier bands from ten lines upward
Open one slab for editing without changing its values and save it
Assert the save is accepted and the slab list is still shown

name: Reports page renders every reporting section
description: Confirms the reporting screen loads with its roll-up sections rather than a partial page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Reports
Assert the page loads without a server error and shows its summary figures
Assert a city-wise records section and a year-wise records section are both present

name: Changing the password rejects a wrong current password
description: Confirms the change password screen verifies the existing password before accepting a new one.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Account/ChangePassword
Enter WrongCurrent123 as the current password and NewPass@1234 as the new password twice, then submit
Assert the change is refused with a message about the current password, and the password has not changed

name: Changing the password rejects mismatched confirmation
description: Confirms the two new password fields must agree.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Account/ChangePassword
Enter Nexus@2026 as the current password, NewPass@1234 as the new password and Something@9999 as the confirmation, then submit
Assert the change is refused and a message explains the two new passwords do not match

name: Change password form blocks an empty submission
description: Confirms the change password screen validates its required fields.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Account/ChangePassword and submit the form with every field left blank
Assert validation messages are shown for the required fields and the submission is not accepted

name: Sidebar offers only the sections the signed-in role may use
description: Confirms the navigation reflects the role rather than showing every link to everyone.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Assert the sidebar shows the billing section
Assert the sidebar does not show a link to /Admin/Plans. Hiding a link is not authorisation on its own, but showing it would be a navigation leak.
Sign out and sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Assert the sidebar shows the installations or operations section and does not show /Admin/Vendors

name: The topbar account menu opens and closes
description: Confirms the account menu is usable and closes when it should.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Click the account chip in the top bar
Assert the account menu is visible and offers a link to the profile and a sign out control
Press the Escape key
Assert the account menu is no longer visible

name: Submitting the same form twice does not create two records
description: Confirms a repeated submission is not recorded twice.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Charges and raise a charge of 321 with the description E2E Double Submit against the first available connection
Assert exactly one pending charge with that description is listed, not two

name: Signed-out users cannot reach any dashboard
description: Confirms every role dashboard is closed to an anonymous visitor.

planSteps.description: Without signing in, navigate directly to /Admin/Dashboard
Assert the browser is sent to /Account/Login
Without signing in, navigate directly to /Accounts/Dashboard
Assert the browser is sent to /Account/Login
Without signing in, navigate directly to /Technical/Dashboard
Assert the browser is sent to /Account/Login
Without signing in, navigate directly to /Customer/Dashboard
Assert the browser is sent to /Account/Login

name: Unknown identifiers fail gracefully across the lookup screens
description: Confirms lookup screens report a miss rather than erroring.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Orders/Tracking and search for the order id ZZZ0000000
Assert a clear not-found message is shown and no server error page appears
Navigate to /Retail/Search and search for the account id ZZZ000000000000
Assert an empty result state is shown rather than an error
Navigate to /Account/Status and submit an unknown account id
Assert a clear not-found message is shown rather than a server error
